messages.text: Searched the catalog · Magic Miner 40T Harlo H15 Dual

Under 12¢ is good territory for this unit. At 40 TH/s it pulls ~650W, so about 474 kWh a month — roughly $57 at 12¢. Dial it to Eco (30 TH/s, 450W) and it's about $39.

It's $799 for Batch 6, 50 units, solo mining to your own node.

Where would it be running — country and room?

context.pop: What do you pay for power? I'll run the Magic Miner 40T numbers for where you live.
